com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.metadata.schema

Class FunctionSignature

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.metadata.schema.FunctionSignature
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Serializable

    @Immutable
public class FunctionSignature
extends Object
implements Serializable
    The signature that uniquely identifies a CQL function or aggregate in a keyspace.

    It's composed of a name and a list of parameter types. Overloads (such as sum(int) and sum(int, int) are not equal.

    See Also:
